classification.difficultyReason: Distinguishes reflection of negative outputs, reflection of a retained half-graph, and their composition.

inlines.text: Match the following graphs with their equations.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 12, given graph above the matching instruction.
spec.description: Unticked black Cartesian axes and an asymmetric smooth blue curve, with a small positive hump left of the vertical axis, a deeper negative trough right of it, and passage through the origin.
spec.mathematics: An unspecified schematic function. Construction coordinates are unlabelled drawing coordinates, not additional numerical givens. Preserve three horizontal-axis crossings, unequal extrema and opposite tail directions.

spec.description: Symmetric nonnegative blue curve with two equal rounded humps, sharp contacts at three horizontal-axis positions, rising outer tails, and a pale dashed original reference curve.
spec.mathematics: Retain the original right half, reflect its negative trough upwards, then reflect that half across the vertical axis. Internal coordinates do not supply numerical values.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent candidate figure; its matching equation is not printed on the graph.

spec.description: Symmetric blue curve with two equal small positive humps, a sharp contact at the origin and descending outer tails. The original right half appears as a pale dashed reference.
spec.mathematics: Keep the original left half and reflect a copy across the vertical axis. Internal coordinates do not supply numerical values.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent candidate figure; its matching equation is not printed on the graph.

spec.description: Nonnegative blue curve with a smaller rounded hump left of the origin and a larger rounded hump right of it, sharp contacts at the original three roots, rising tails and pale dashed negative reference portions.
spec.mathematics: Preserve positive portions of the original curve and reflect only its negative portions across the horizontal axis. Internal coordinates do not supply numerical values.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent candidate figure; its matching equation is not printed on the graph.

spec.description: Symmetric blue curve with a sharp peak at the origin, two equal negative troughs and rising outer tails. The original left half appears as a pale dashed reference.
spec.mathematics: Keep the original right half and reflect a copy across the vertical axis. Internal coordinates do not supply numerical values.
spec.answerVisibility: Permanent candidate figure; its matching equation is not printed on the graph.

answer.worked: (III). Keep the portions above the $x$-axis and reflect the portions below it across the $x$-axis. The two humps remain unequal.
(IV). Keep the right half of $y=f(x)$ and reflect a copy across the $y$-axis. This gives two equal negative troughs.
(II). Since $-|x|\leq0$, keep the left half of $y=f(x)$ and reflect a copy across the $y$-axis. This gives two equal small positive humps and descending outer tails.

(I). First keep the right half and reflect a copy across the $y$-axis. Then reflect the negative portions across the $x$-axis. The result is symmetric about the $y$-axis and entirely on or above the $x$-axis.
